page.layout: Two parallel columns of Hebrew-Latin dictionary entries, left column then right column, with the printed page number 449 at top right. No margin notes, no footnotes.

main_text.p: fut. Niph. 2. pl. m. R. עָלָה.
תַּעֲלוּלִים facinora, No. pl. m. R. עָלַל fecit.
תַּעֲלָה aquaeductus, תַּעֲלוֹתֶיהָ aquaeductus sui, s. f. constr. & pl. f. aff. No. תְּעָלָה, R. עָלָה ascendit.
תַּעַן loqueris, vel respondebit, (apoc. pro) תַּעֲנֶה, תַּעֲנֵנִי exaudias nos, ני.. me, תַּעֲנוּ respondebitis, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. ut & 2. pl. m. Rad. עָנָה.
תַּעֲנֶה afflixeris, vel rit, תַּעֲנוּ affligetis, תַּעֲנֶה affligeris, vel tur, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. & 2. pl. m. ut & fut. Pual, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. עָנָה respondit.
תַּעֲנוּגֶיהָ deliciae suae, תַּעֲנוּגוֹת deliciae, pl. m. aff. & pl. f. No. תַּעֲנוּג; Rad. עָנַג deliciari.
תַּעֲנִיק munerabis, vel bit, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. עָנַק.
תַּעֲנָנָה respondebunt, Jud. 5. 29. pro תַּעֲנֶינָה, fut. Kal, 3. pl. f. Rad. עָנָה.
תַּעֲפָה evolabis, Job. 11. 17. pro תָּשׁוּף, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. parag. praeter morem. Rad. עוּף.
תַּעֲצְבוּ dolore afficiamini, תַּעֲצְלוּ pigri fiatis, fut. Niph. 2. pl. m. Rad. עָצַב, & עָצַל.
וְתֵּעָצֵר & cohibitus es, vel ta est, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. עָצַר.
תֵּעַר nudabis, Pf. 141. 8. (apoc. pro תְּעָרָה,) fut. Piel, 2. f. m. Rad. עָרָה.
בְּ־תַּעֲרָה in vagina sua, praef. & aff. cum No. Rad. תַּעַר novacula.
תַּעַשׂ facies, vel et, (apoc. pro תַּעֲשֶׂה,) תַּעֲשִׂי facietis, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. ut & 2. pl. m. Rad. עָשָׂה.
וְתַּעַשׂ & fiet, (apoc. pro) תַּעֲשֶׂה; fut. Niph. 3. f. f. Rad.

page.notes: Vowel points and some Hebrew letters in the scan are small and blurred, especially in the upper left (תַּעֲלוֹתֶיהָ) and the blot over "loqueris" (תַּעַן). The left and right page numbers are not printed, only 449 at top right. The Hebrew running head is the same on both columns. The last line of the right column is cut off at the foot of the scan; the final word "Rad:" is the printed text as far as it is legible.
